definitions.explanation: A man and woman who are married to each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{理想的|りそうてき}→理想的：04797_risouteki⟧な{夫婦|ふうふ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: They are an ideal married couple.

examples.japanese: {夫婦|ふうふ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: We plan to travel as a couple.

examples.japanese: {夫婦|ふうふ}⟦{喧嘩|げんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|く}わない→食う：02657_kuu⟧。
examples.english: Even a dog won't eat a married couple's quarrel. [Proverb: Don't interfere in marital disputes]
examples.notes: Proverb meaning outsiders shouldn't get involved in marital disputes

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{夫婦|ふうふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}して→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: That couple has been married for thirty years, but they always get along well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{共働|ともばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夫婦|ふうふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分担|ぶんたん}する→分担：11771_buntan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: The number of dual-income couples has increased, and sharing housework has become the norm.
examples.notes: ⟦{共働|ともばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧ = dual-income (both spouses working)

notes:
USAGE: {夫婦|ふうふ} is the standard formal term for a married couple. Can also be read めおと in more traditional contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{夫婦|ふうふ}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (married life)
・{夫婦|ふうふ}⟦{喧嘩|げんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧ (marital quarrel)
・{夫婦|ふうふ}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (marital relationship)
・{夫婦|ふうふ}⟦{円満|えんまん}→円満：17922_enman⟧ (marital harmony)
・⟦{新婚|しんこん}→新婚：12879_shinkon⟧{夫婦|ふうふ} (newlywed couple)
・⟦{老|ろう}{夫婦|ふうふ}→老夫婦：15452_roufuufu⟧ (elderly couple)

RELATED WORDS:
・⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧ - husband
・⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧ - wife
